Uttarakhand Gurdwara Standoff Concludes Peacefully After Negotiations

A standoff at a gurdwara in Uttarakhand involving Nihang Sikhs and authorities has been resolved peacefully. Nihang Sikhs vacated the premises following discussions, with officials reporting the end of the situation. The event involved negotiations and led to the release of some individuals on bail.
